newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala September consumer prices rise 0.34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala September consumer prices rise 0.34 pct.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.34 percent in September, compared to a rise of 0.57 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Friday.
August inflation this year was 0.98 percent.
Accumulated inflation was 8.26 percent at the end of September, compared with 5.20 percent a year ago, the institute said.
Year-over-year inflation was 11.77 percent on September 30, down from 12.03 percent as of August 31. Year-over-year inflation at the end of September 1995 was 8.13 percent.
